verdict.rationale: Jeeves's own docs say it puts multi-currency cash accounts with yield, corporate card issuing with spend controls, expense management, and bill pay with invoice scanning and approval flows in "one digital account" (docs-38). The homepage also explicitly pitches replacing a five-tool finance stack with one platform (docs-48), which matches the founder's consolidation goal. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the platform actually replaces separate tools, and evidence of how deep the banking is beyond holding and converting USD/EUR/GBP/CAD (e.g., whether it can serve as the primary operating account).
